description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-review PR / diff review skill

test_cases.name: PR Diff Review Trigger
test_cases.description: Ensures pull-request and change-set reviews check hexagonal boundaries, catalog impact, and XFN completeness.
test_cases.prompt: Please do a pull request review of this diff before merge. Walk the change set for hexagonal boundaries and catalog honesty.

test_cases.name: Drop a review finding that was not reproduced
test_cases.description: A finding stays only when the review names the command that was run and the output it printed.
test_cases.prompt: Review this pull request and close the findings.

required_patterns: Keep a finding that names the command and the output
Drop a finding that has no command and no output

test_cases.name: Review names the command that proved a port change
test_cases.description: When the change crosses a port, review keeps the done line that names the command and what it printed.
test_cases.prompt: Review this CLI change that crosses a port.

required_patterns: Done line names the command that was run and what it printed

test_cases.name: Count dropped findings and name the review model
test_cases.description: A review says how many findings were dropped, uses one model by default, and uses a host overlay slug as the second pass.
test_cases.prompt: Review this pull request and close the findings.

required_patterns: Say how many findings were dropped
a second model is not configured
that slug is the second pass
